argv: $p=Get-Process chrome,node,python,py,powershell -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Sort-Object WorkingSet64 -Descending | Select-Object -First 25 Name,Id,@{n='WorkingSetMB';e={[math]::Round($_.WorkingSet64/1MB,1)}},@{n='PrivateMB';e={[math]::Round($_.PrivateMemorySize64/1MB,1)}},CPU,StartTime; $p|ConvertTo-Json -Compress -Depth 4; try{$s=Invoke-RestMethod 'http://127.0.0.1:17448/api/status' -TimeoutSec 5; Write-Output '===BRIDGE_STATUS==='; $s|ConvertTo-Json -Compress -Depth 6}catch{Write-Output ('===BRIDGE_STATUS_ERR==='+$_.Exception.Message)}

note: Read-only post-restart process memory and Bridge status
